description.de: Aggregiert Build-Status und offene Quality-TODOs zu einer Release-Entscheidung: FREIGEGEBEN / BLOCKIERT / MIT VORBEHALT
description.en: Aggregates build status and open quality TODOs into a release decision: APPROVED / BLOCKED / CONDITIONAL

instructions:
You write a release readiness report for MySuricates. Aggregate the build status and the open quality TODOs and give a clear release recommendation.

Run isolation: work only in {{ execution_path }}. The original path {{ project_path }} identifies the project and must not be written to. No automatic merges, pushes or switches to main/master. Changes stay on the run branch for explicit adoption. If a technical check failed, a report must not claim success. Checked commit: {{ workspace_source_sha }}; logs: {{ workspace_logs }}.
author: MySuricates

config.label: Collect build status and version info
config.command:
set -uo pipefail
command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'WARN: mvn not available — backend compile check skipped'; MVN_MISSING=1; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'WARN: npm not available — frontend build check skipped'; NPM_MISSING=1; }
command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'WARN: git not available — version info incomplete'; GIT_MISSING=1; }
cd '{{ execution_path }}' || { echo 'project_path not reachable: {{ execution_path }}'; echo 'gate_status: RED'; echo 'gate_category: release-readiness'; echo 'gate_description: project_path not reachable'; exit 1; }

echo '=== Current version ==='
VERSION=$(grep '<version>' ai-automation-backend/pom.xml | head -1 | sed 's/.*<version>\(.*\)<\/version>/\1/' | tr -d ' ' || echo '?')
if [ -z "${GIT_MISSING:-}" ]; then
  TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo 'no tag')
  LAST_COMMIT=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:'%h %s (%cr)' 2>/dev/null || echo '?')
else
  TAG='?'
  LAST_COMMIT='?'
fi
echo "POM Version: $VERSION"
echo "Last tag: $TAG"
echo "Last commit: $LAST_COMMIT"
echo ''

config.label: Write the release report
config.command:
Write the release readiness report for MySuricates.

## Build and version info
Version: {{ step_0_output }}
Backend: {{ step_1_output }}
Frontend: {{ step_2_output }}

## Open TODOs (all projects)
{{ open_todos }}

## Previous report (for trend analysis)
{{ previous_report }}

## Report format

### MySuricates release readiness
**Version**: [from the POM]
**Date**: [today]
**Assessment**: APPROVED / CONDITIONAL / BLOCKED

### Build status
| Component | Status |
|------------|--------|
| Backend (mvn compile) | |
| Frontend (npm run build) | |
| Git tag | |
| Last commit | |

### Open quality TODOs
Group the open TODOs from the list above by category/tag:

| Category/tag | Count | Highest priority |
|---------------|--------|---------------------|
| audit:test-coverage / testing | | |
| audit:arch-debt / architektur | | |
| audit:security / security | | |
| performance | | |
| backend (bugs) | | |

### Release decision
- **APPROVED**: build OK, no HIGH TODOs in quality categories
- **CONDITIONAL**: build OK, some HIGH TODOs (max. 5)
- **BLOCKED**: build fails OR >5 HIGH TODOs OR critical security TODOs open

### Prerequisites for the release (if not APPROVED)
1. [What still has to be done — name concrete TODO IDs]

At the end, output exactly these lines:

gate_status: GREEN if APPROVED, YELLOW if CONDITIONAL, RED if BLOCKED
gate_category: release-readiness
gate_description: Release [version] — [APPROVED/CONDITIONAL/BLOCKED]

config.label: Gate-Verdict
config.command:
set -uo pipefail
PREV={{ previous_output }}

if echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: RED'; then
  echo 'Release: BLOCKED'
  echo 'gate_status: RED'
  echo 'gate_category: release-readiness'
  echo 'gate_description: Release blocked — prerequisites not met'
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: YELLOW'; then
  echo 'Release: CONDITIONAL'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: release-readiness'
  echo 'gate_description: Release possible with reservations'
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: GREEN'; then
  echo 'Release: APPROVED'
  echo 'gate_status: GREEN'
  echo 'gate_category: release-readiness'
  echo 'gate_description: Release approved'
else
  echo 'Release: INCOMPLETE'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: release-readiness'
  echo 'gate_description: Result incomplete — no gate status in the report (AI block failed or unclear)'
fi
